meta.name: buzz-social
meta.description: Social media strategy and post drafting — HN posts, Twitter/X threads, LinkedIn posts, Reddit comments, and developer community content. Use when asked to "write a HN post", "draft social posts", "help us post on Twitter", or "create a social launch plan".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为社交平台撰写策略帖子和发布计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个社交平台上规划并发布内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan and post content across multiple social platforms

howto.what: Claude 会像一个 PR 和社区工程师，根据你指定的平台和目的，按照各平台规则撰写社交媒体帖子和策略建议，包括 HN、Twitter/X、LinkedIn、Reddit、GitHub、Bluesky 等。
howto.when: 当你说“写一篇 HN 帖子”、“起草社交帖子”、“在 Twitter 上发布”，或提及社交发布计划时。

say.text: 帮我写一篇 HN 的 Show HN 帖子，介绍我们的工具。
say.note: Claude 会按 HN 规范生成标题和内容。

say.text: 为新产品起草一条 Twitter/X 线程。
say.note: 你会得到包含钩子、上下文和 CTA 的完整线程。

say.text: 写一篇关于技术趋势的 LinkedIn 文章，吸引开发者。
say.note: Claude 会提供个人故事和可扫描的段落。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a PR & community engineer, drafting social media posts and strategy for platforms like HN, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Reddit, GitHub, and Bluesky following each platform's rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to "write a HN post", "draft social posts", "post on Twitter", or mention creating a social launch plan.

say_en.text: Write a Show HN post for our tool.
say_en.note: Claude follows HN conventions for title and content.

say_en.text: Draft a Twitter/X thread for our new product.
say_en.note: You get a full thread with hook, context, and CTA.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn article about tech trends for developers.
say_en.note: Claude provides a personal story and scannable paragraphs.
